title: Rav Binyamin Knopelmacher Passes
body: Rav Binyamin Zev Knopelmacher zt”l, a renowned Breslover mashpia, passed away at 75 after years of illness. Thousands sought his brocha and counsel, regarding him as a leading spiritual guide in Breslov.

title: Religious Zionists Weigh Draft Law
body: Religious Zionist party leaders, including leading Rabbonim, are considering supporting the government's draft law, which grants wide exemptions to the chareidi tzibbur, after intense consultations.
